title: Franco-Nevada (FNV) and Sandstorm Gold (SAND) Deep Dive Analysis

framework_lessons: Conditional project upside requires a successful trigger.
assessment: The GBTC discount boundary and Sandstorm dilution expectation failed, while eventual ETF conversion did bring the discount close to NAV. The Hod Maden schedule failed, distinct from its conditional doubling scenario. Gold new highs and royalty-project concentration warnings were supported.
